lines.t: (Verse 1)
A whisper calls beyond the veil,
A breath of truth the winds exhale.
I close my eyes, the noise fades low,
And in the stillness, His voice is love.
Be still, and hear His heart,
When all the world falls apart.
The stars remember every word,
The first light still echoes what they heard.
He walks among the broken,
And calls His children by their names.
The lost, the weary, the unsure —
He gathers all to love once more.
The mountains shake, the hills bow,
But in His voice, I’m found somehow.
The truth resounds in mercy and fire,
A song of mercy, pure desire.
(Chorus)
The voice in the stillness — calling me home,
Breaking the silence, I’m never alone.
The word eternal, the promise divine,
Light everlasting, forever mine.
The heavens tremble, the heart awakes,
Every chain of doubt He breaks.
The voice in the stillness —
Whispers my name.
(Verse 2)
The pages turn, the prophets weep,
The heart remembers what He speaks.
Every moment, every breath,
Echoes His love beyond death.
“My child, come walk with Me,
Beyond the waves, beyond the sea.
Your pain is known, and I hold the key.”
And in the thunder, I still hear,
The voice that wipes away my fear.
A fire burns where night once reigned,
And every scar is grace reclaimed.
(Chorus)
The voice in the stillness — calling me home,
Breaking the silence, I’m never alone.
The word eternal, the promise divine,
Light everlasting, forever mine.
The heavens tremble, the heart awakes,
Every chain of doubt He breaks.
The voice in the stillness —
Whispers my name.
Oh, truth that never fades away,
Oh, love that leads me through the flames.
In dreams, in light, in waking dawn,
Your voice still leads me on and on.
Every kingdom, every throne,
Falls before You, God alone.
All creation lifts its song —
The voice of truth forever strong!
The voice in the stillness — calling me home,
Breaking the silence, I’m never alone.
The word eternal, the promise divine,
Light everlasting, forever mine.
Forever You are holy flame,
Forever love, forever name.
The voice in the stillness —
Whispers my name.
And when the stars forget to shine,
Still, Your truth remains divine.
The voice in the stillness…
Still calls to mine.
